# FunderMaps

> FunderMaps is a Dutch geospatial platform for foundation-risk assessment of buildings. It ingests cadastral data (BAG), subsidence measurements and 3DBAG, runs a risk model over ~11.2M Dutch buildings, and surfaces the results to clients (insurers, banks, mortgage lenders, municipalities, surveyors) through a webservice, a customer app and PDF reports.

This site is the Dutch-language marketing front for FunderMaps. The product itself lives at separate subdomains (see "External product surfaces").

## Primary pages

- [Home / Inzicht in funderingsrisico's](https://fundermaps.com/): Hero, services overview, references, demo, partners.
- [Funderingstypes & risico's](https://fundermaps.com/media-library.html): Visual reference of foundation types (rotterdamse fundering, betonpaal, kespen, etc.) and their associated risks.
- [Artikelen](https://fundermaps.com/artikelen.html): Articles on funderingsproblematiek — causes, repair, municipal policy, practical guidance.

## Apps & tools (sub-products)

- [Nationaal Funderingsherstel Register](https://fundermaps.com/nationaal-herstelregister.html): Public register for completed foundation-repair work, supporting taxation, transactions and policy.
- [Stand van het Land](https://fundermaps.com/stand-van-het-land.html): National foundation figures from the FunderMaps database: foundation types, risk classes A–E, construction periods and restoration costs.
- [Hoe FunderMaps het funderingsrisico bepaalt](https://fundermaps.com/hoe-het-model-werkt.html): How the FunderMaps model determines foundation type and risk class A–E, the four foundation risks, the hierarchy of evidence and the data behind it.
- [Informatiestandaard funderingsgegevens](https://fundermaps.com/informatiestandaard.html): The FunderMaps information standard 1.0 for foundation data: terms, units, value lists and map colours (CC BY 4.0).
- [Begrippen, standaarden en catalogus](https://fundermaps.com/begrippen-en-standaarden.html): How FunderMaps defines its terms (NL-SBB), information model (MIM 1.2), data catalogue (DCAT-AP-NL) and calculation rules, and which datasets it uses.
- [Kennisbank](https://fundermaps.com/kennisbank.html): Index of the FunderMaps knowledge pages.
- [FunderMaps API](https://fundermaps.com/api.html): What the API delivers (light, risk, analysis, statistics), how access and billing work, and who it is for.
- [FunderMaps API v4](https://fundermaps.com/api-documentatie.html): The current FunderMaps product API reference (endpoints, authentication, fields, errors, rate limits).

## External product surfaces

- [FunderMaps Maps](https://maps.fundermaps.com/): Interactive map viewer.
- [FunderMaps App](https://app.fundermaps.com/): Customer dashboard for inquiries, recoveries, samples.
- [FunderMaps Admin](https://admin.fundermaps.com/): Admin console for FunderMaps staff.
- [FunderMaps Analytics](https://analytics.fundermaps.com/): Dashboards built on the FunderMaps dataset.
